finding.seed_assignment: demo/seed.py puts inventory entries with i<2 on Ambulance 61; fixture order is Nitrile gloves then Training oxygen cylinder. Other two entries belong to Firehouse51 station.
finding.migration: MigrateLegacyAsync creates a typed Unit holder with source.UnitId preserved. NewLegacyLocation labels that holder simply Unit. The displayed location name is not the apparatus identity.
finding.retained_transfer: Legacy actual operation inventory-transfer moved five Academy training battery packs from Station to the existing generic Unit holder. It did not create a new Engine51 location.
finding.inference_bound: Taken together, retained source and action provenance identify the five-pack destination as the migrated Ambulance61 holder. This is not a fresh server-state query and cannot exclude a later unrecorded movement. Confirm the current Unit UI before recording any stock claim.
finding.reported_current_observation: Parent normal UI currently shows Inventory · Engine51 and No inventory is assigned to this unit. No count was started. This is parent-reported provenance, not a new child capture.
finding.api_model: No old/new API split: Unit uses modern v4 /Inventory/GetAccess and /Inventory/GetUnitEquipment. Access locates a nondeleted Unit-type root whose UnitId equals active unit and no parent/container; equipment matches effective holder.UnitId.
finding.absence_bound: No inventory assigned means returned locations are empty; permissions/visibility or absent holder can produce that screen. It is not a physical inventory observation.

next_normal_ui_sequence.action: Confirm current apparatus, then use Settings → Active Unit to select Ambulance61 through normal permitted UI. Open Inventory; focusing reloads selected-unit access/equipment.
next_normal_ui_sequence.guard: Do not change roster, status, permissions or inventory assignments merely to force this screen.

next_normal_ui_sequence.action: Inspect Recent counts. If an appropriate Draft already exists, open it instead of creating a duplicate. Otherwise inspect Count the inventory and optional Where to count / Whole unit selector, then Start count once.
next_normal_ui_sequence.guard: Start count appears only with Enabled, Migrated, CanCount and a visible unit location.

next_normal_ui_sequence.action: Inspect every generated line, Expected value, lot/serial and difference/progress summary. Quantity lines use numeric entry, One less/One more and Matches; serialized lines use Present/Missing only when actually present.
required_capture: visible numeric field or serialized controls
next_normal_ui_sequence.guard: Do not invent serialized items or treat a software count as physical stock inspection.

next_normal_ui_sequence.action: For a permitted training draft, record explicit software-only matching observations as intended; Save progress, navigate back normally, reopen the same Draft and verify persisted counted values.
next_normal_ui_sequence.guard: Saving progress stores observations; it does not post a stock adjustment.

next_normal_ui_sequence.action: Treat Complete and Cancel count as separate later operations; require an actual working confirmation plus stored resulting state before claiming them.
next_normal_ui_sequence.guard: Current web Alert is an installed no-op; do not use hidden calls/API/store or make a native confirmation claim.

web_and_authority_limits: Count Complete and Cancel count directly call react-native Alert.alert; installed react-native-web Alert.alert is an empty function. Their web confirmation/result remains unsupported unless separately fixed and actually retested.

Complete is disabled until every line is observed. Differences post on completion, not Save progress. A controlled-item difference may wait for a second-person witness on the web; Unit does not provide independent witness signing.
Counts use optimistic revision and snapshot guards. Changed stock can reject the snapshot; do not bypass conflicts.
No provider, camera, GPS, real stock inspection, MFA or role changes are part of this source-only preparation.
qualification: No count tutorial, canonical, voice, video or publication is frozen by this report. Existing Unit03 route/inventory draft remains incomplete.
